note: Conceptual/architecture lesson overviewing the three real Event Monitoring tools (Event Log Files, Event Log Objects, Real-Time Event Monitoring) and Transaction Security Policies as the action layer on top. No screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy -- taught through a comparison table and a tool-selection scenario Lab. Exact retention periods and lookup-delay figures vary across the sources checked (e.g. Salesforce's own architect guide vs. third-party summaries disagree on specific minute/day counts), so this lesson describes those qualitatively ("a delay," "scheduled intervals") rather than citing a specific number that couldn't be confirmed as current, per the brief's guidance against inventing unverifiable specifics.
